gaps.title: Github Actions CI/CD absent (no build/test gates)
gaps.description: The repository lacks any GitHub Actions workflows to build/test backend and frontend. For a capstone project, this means no automated quality gates (tests, lint, formatting, dependency vuln scans) on PR or merge.
gaps.evidence: Repo tree at commit 1961d841. No .github/workflows/* directory or YAML workflow files present.
gaps.impact: Regressions can merge undetected; lower confidence in releases; manual reduced quality and operational readiness.
